scope_note: This is a passage-level inventory of known Hebrew witnesses, not a claim that all listed chapter ranges survive continuously or that every verse in a range is extant. Fragmentary, damaged, and restored portions remain distinct.

chapter_summary.caveat: The seven chapters listed as lacking Hebrew witnesses may still be represented by ancient Greek and Syriac versions. A chapter listed as having Hebrew evidence may contain substantial gaps.

limitations: Do not interpolate missing verses between scattered citations.

reconstruction_rules: For each verse, transcribe direct Hebrew witnesses first and retain each manuscript reading separately.
Use 2Q18 only for its attested fragment lines in Sirach 6; do not reconstruct the whole chapter from it.
Use Mas1h only for its preserved Sirach 39:27-44:17 portion.
Cross-link Sirach 51:13-20,30 in 11Q5 while preserving the Psalms-scroll identity.
Use Genizah A-F only at their reported passage coverage; do not fill gaps between isolated fragments by assumption.
Where Hebrew is absent, compare the earliest Greek and Syriac textual forms for the same passage; mark any Hebrew retroversion as editorial and never as an ancient Hebrew witness.
If no reliable witness supplies the missing passage, retain an explicit unresolved gap.
